inventory.title: Blind vs Blind: Small Blind Strategy (first action)
inventory.reason: Same node key as page 3 'Raise First In (RFI): Small Blind' (four folds, actor SB), so no second node is created. Reconciled: the page-6 first action (Raise/4bet, Raise/Call, Raise/Fold = raise 3bb; Limp/Raise, Limp/Call, Limp/Fold = limp; Fold = fold) equals the page-3 grid in 169/169 cells, and the page-6 combo totals 58+120+144 = 322 raise, 68+204+232 = 504 limp, 500 fold equal page 3's 322/504/500. The single node is the page-3 transcription.

inventory.title: Blind vs Blind: Big Blind vs SB Limp
inventory.reason: Grid transcribed (169/169 cells). Four folds, SB limps (call), actor BB. Actions check / raise to 3.5bb (to_bb_x1000 3500; page 2: 3.5x raise facing a small blind limp). The legend's third row 'Fold 0.0% 0/1326' is omitted from the menu: the BB owes nothing after a limp, so fold is not a legal action (core_model offers Check, not Fold).

inventory.title: Blind vs Blind: Big Blind vs SB raise
inventory.reason: Grid transcribed (169/169 cells). Four folds, SB raises to 3bb, actor BB. Actions fold / call / raise to 10.5bb (to_bb_x1000 10500): the legend labels the raise '3bet'; the big blind has position on the small blind, so page 2's in-position 3bet rule (3.5x of 3bb) applies.

inventory.title: Blind vs Blind: Small Blind Strategy (second action after Raise, facing the Big Blind 3bet)
inventory.reason: RFI response to a later 3bet, SB only. The page-6 Small Blind Strategy colours every SB raising hand with its complete response to the BB 3bet (Raise/4bet, Raise/Call, Raise/Fold: 58+120+144 = 322 combos = the whole page-3 raise range); opponent scope is the BB alone (four folds, SB opens, BB 3bets); sizes come from page 2: SB open 3bb, BB in-position 3bet 3.5x = 10.5bb, SB out-of-position 4bet 2.5x of 10.5bb = 26.25bb (to_bb_x1000 26250). Actions fold / call / raise 26.25bb. The 119 classes the SB limps or folds first (preceding raise weight exactly 0 on page 3) are unreachable_classes with all-zero weights.

inventory.title: Blind vs Blind: Small Blind Strategy (second action after Limp, facing the Big Blind raise)
inventory.reason: Unresolved size, not loadable. Page 6 colours the SB limping hands Limp/Raise, Limp/Call, Limp/Fold, and the BB raise after a limp is 3.5bb (page 2), but no page states the size of the SB's re-raise after limping (page 2 sizes RFI, 3bets, the BB raise facing a limp, and 4bets only; the chart calls this action 'Raise', not '3bet'). A node would need a raise-to amount, which is never assigned without a published size.
